title: 20-Year Treasury constant maturity yield
author: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US)

chunks.heading: What it measures
chunks.body: DGS20 is the daily 20-year constant-maturity Treasury yield quoted on an investment basis, sourced from the Federal Reserve H.15 release.

chunks.heading: Non-equivalence
chunks.body: A yield series is not a TLT total-return or tradable price series: duration, convexity, coupon income, fund fees and rebalancing are absent. It may label regimes, but must not replace TLT OHLC in a strategy backtest.
